{"Content":"import os
import shutil

import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(cat_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)

    "4A 305-Full Adhesive-300",   # B07QXJZKHC (174 FBA)

    tpl_groups.setdefault(tpl, []).append(r)

print(f"Total MFN SKUs with Qty > 0: {len(mfn_active)} (Total Units: {sum(int(r['quantity']) for r in mfn_active):,})")
